40: class ProtocolRunner(abc.ABC):
41:     """An interface to manage and control a protocol run.
42: 
43:     The ProtocolRunner is primarily responsible for feeding a ProtocolEngine
44:     with commands and control signals. These commands and signals are
45:     generated by protocol files, hardware signals, or externally via
46:     the HTTP robot-server.
47: 
48:     A ProtocolRunner controls a single run. Once the run is finished,
49:     you will need a new ProtocolRunner to do another run.
50:     """
51: 
52:     @abc.abstractmethod
53:     def was_started(self) -> bool:
54:         """Whether the runner has been started.
55: 
56:         This value is latched; once it is True, it will never become False.
57:         """
58: 
59:     @abc.abstractmethod
60:     async def load(self, protocol_source: ProtocolSource) -> None:
61:         """Load a ProtocolSource into managed ProtocolEngine.
62: 
63:         Calling this method is only necessary if the runner will be used
64:         to control the run of a file-based protocol.
65:         """
66: 
67:     @abc.abstractmethod
68:     def play(self) -> None:
69:         """Start or resume the run."""
70: 
71:     @abc.abstractmethod
72:     def pause(self) -> None:
73:         """Pause the run."""
74: 
75:     @abc.abstractmethod
76:     async def stop(self) -> None:
77:         """Stop (cancel) the run."""
78: 
79:     @abc.abstractmethod
80:     async def run(
81:         self,
82:         protocol_source: Optional[ProtocolSource] = None,
83:     ) -> ProtocolRunResult:
84:         """Run a given protocol to completion."""
85: 
86:
